records.name: _dmarc.harborline.example
records.note: Only if the domain has no DMARC record yet. Never publish two.

manualSteps: Add harborline.example to Cloudflare (DNS must be on Cloudflare) if it is not already a zone.
Dashboard → harborline.example → Email → Email Routing → Enable. Let it add the MX, SPF and DKIM records.
Email Routing → Routing rules → Catch-all address → Action "Send to a Worker" → cloudmail → Save, and make sure it is enabled.

If harborline.example has no DMARC record, add TXT _dmarc.harborline.example = "v=DMARC1; p=reject;". If one exists, keep it.
Back here, press "Re-check DNS" until every row passes.
